name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-12-01, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
